rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a pastime or activity used to occupy the mind.

example.english: I like reading as a diversion in my daily life.
example.traditional: 我平日鍾意睇書當消遣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 jat6 zung1 ji3 tai2 syu1 dong3 siu1 hin2

rows.note: Use this abstract noun for the shifting or redirecting of attention, activity, or resources.

example.english: The diversion of everyone's attention is part of the plan.
example.traditional: 轉移大家注意力係呢個計劃嘅一部分。
example.jyutping: zyun2 ji4 daai6 gaa1 zyu3 ji3 lik6 hai6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6

rows.note: Use this colloquial noun for a detour or a longer route taken because the usual route is unavailable.

example.english: The road ahead is closed, so we have to take a diversion to get home.
example.traditional: 前面封咗路，我哋要兜路先返到屋企。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 fung1 zo2 lou6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 dau1 lou6 sin1 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this noun for a decoy tactic that makes people focus on the wrong place or action.

example.english: They made a big show in the east as a diversion; the real action was in the west.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺東面大鑼大鼓，其實只係聲東擊西，真正嘅行動喺西面。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dung1 min6 daai6 lo4 daai6 gu2 kei4 sat6 zi2 hai6 sing1 dung1 gik1 sai1 zan1 zing3 ge3 hang4 dung6 hai2 sai1 min6
